thread:
anika: quick sync? thinking about how the console surfaces per-tenant SLOs when tenants hit quota throttles + routing fallbacks. do we show the original configured threshold or the effective one? :thinking_face:

samir: lean toward showing both: 'configured' and 'effective' (after throttles/fallbacks). UI: two-line summary + a tooltip linking to evaluation details. preview toggle to simulate routing effects. :+1:

leo: agree. need API support for a preview mode so console can ask 'what would my alert do right now' without firing real notifs. proposal: add a query param to the SLO evaluate endpoint, e.g. `/v1/slos/:id/evaluate?preview=true`. example payload we're using for local test:```json
{"tenant_id":"acme-corp","lookback":"5m","preview":true}```

maria: big :100: on preventing real notifs during previews. also worried about noise — if effective SLO auto-degrades due to routing to cheaper model, should that show as an active alert? maybe show a yellow warning state (degraded) separate from red (breach).

samir: yes. states: OK / DEGRADED / BREACHED. DEGRADED means SLO still meets goal but via fallback or lower-quality model. Breached triggers real alerts (unless preview). For API, add `state_reason` and `applied_policy` in evaluation response so console can render a small card with what changed. lightweight example:```json
{
  "state":"DEGRADED",
  "state_reason":"routed-to-quantized-variant",
  "applied_policy":"route:cost-priority"
}```

leo: telemetry note: evaluation responses must include trace_id + tenant_id + route_variant so we can correlate alerts -> routing decisions. otherwise ops can't figure out "why did tenant X suddenly see degraded SLOs".

anika: agreed. we should also add a sampling flag — full traces for breaches, 1% sampling for routine evaluations. storing everything will blow up costs.

maria: +1. and console should expose a "preview notify" toggle that runs the notify pipeline in dry-run mode and returns list of recipients that would be notified, but does NOT call external providers. show that list as a simulation. important for compliance reviews.

ops-bot: FYI: notify service currently supports `dry_run=true` on POST /internal/notify but it still logs to the audit stream. will need to opt-out for preview if privacy request.

samir: next steps proposal: (1) add evaluate?preview endpoint + `dry_run` to notify, (2) extend evaluation response with state_reason/applied_policy/route_variant/trace_id, (3) console UI shows configured vs effective SLO and simulation for notify. i'll draft the API PR. anyone want ownership on console side for the UX?

leo: i can take the console mockups and a small prototype.

maria: i'll own rollout + runbook updates for how DEGRADED vs BREACHED maps to pager policies.

anika: amazing — thanks. samir, ping when you open the API PR and tag @leo @maria. we should include a couple of unit tests for preview=noop behavior. :eyes:

samir: will do. opening PR in the next few hours.```
